title: LUA-07 second criterion unsatisfied: manifest_hash is produced on ScriptResult but never written into the execution audit record
symptom: LUA-07 (Capability manifest validation) has two acceptance criteria. Criterion 1 -- the manifest hash binds the script source together with its declared capabilities -- is satisfied in src/lua/ by ISS-0169 tranche 1: manifest.zig computes a digest over the script source plus sorted, 0x00-separated capabilities, verifyManifestHash compares it in constant time, and executeScriptWithManifest rejects a mismatch before any Lua state is created. Criterion 2 -- the manifest hash appears in the execution audit record -- is NOT satisfied. src/lua/ produces manifest_hash on ScriptResult, but nothing consumes it: no caller writes it into an audit row, so an operator auditing a script execution cannot tell which script source and which capability set actually ran.
root_cause: Scope boundary, not a defect in the delivered code. The audit row for a script execution is written by the engine (the caller of the Lua executor), not by src/lua/. ISS-0169 tranche 1 was scoped to src/lua/ and correctly stopped at producing the value on ScriptResult. The engine-side plumbing that carries manifest_hash from ScriptResult into the persisted audit record was deliberately left open and recorded in src/design/lua-capability-enforcement.md section 11, follow-up 2.
acceptance_criteria: The engine call site that executes a Lua script reads manifest_hash from ScriptResult and persists it on the execution audit record
The audit record's manifest_hash is queryable for a completed script execution
An integration test asserts that executing a script with a known manifest produces an audit row carrying that exact hash
The test is mutation-checked: dropping the hash write makes it fail
LUA-07 set to RELEASED only once both its criteria are evidenced
notes: Filed per CLAUDE.md 'No Issue Left Local-Only' and the ISSUE_QUEUE forwarding rule rather than expanding ISS-0169 tranche 1's scope onto its branch.
TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF03-ISS-0169-20260806 Step 4b) ruled criterion 2 only partially satisfiable within src/lua and required that LUA-07 not be marked RELEASED by this run.
LUA-07 is therefore left at IN_PROGRESS with an explanatory note. Marking it RELEASED on the strength of the satisfied half would repeat the ISS-0153 pattern that ISS-0169 exists to correct.
